# Podiatry Surgery

# If no antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended, select appropriate order below:

[Select here No antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended for procedure/surgery](orz-gtx-abx-pre-op-url-nurse-generic-order)

[Select here No antimicrobial prophylaxis, already on concurrent antimicrobials](orz-gtx-abx-pre-op-url-nurse-podiatry-order)

# Preferred:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

# Alternative for patients with beta lactam allergy:

[Clindamycin 900 mg IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision](psjizid-clindamy-900mg-iv-once-preop)

($$) [H,O]

# Known MRSA colonization:

[Vancomycin 15 MG/KG IV beginning 120 minutes before incision \($\) R](surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)

References

Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis

in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 Vol 70 page 195-283

Antimicrobial Prophylaxis for Surgery, Treatment Guidelines from The Medical

Letter 2012 Vol 10 pages 73-77
